scenes.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
scenes.desc: Colisión entre industrial y synth-pop: armazón rítmico marcial y bailable al servicio de canciones fronterizas con el rock duro (pero con máquinas).

podcast.title: Presence in Industrial Scene
podcast.body: Pankow was noted as one of the groups that began to catch on in the industrial scene during its growth period in the mid-to-late 1980s. "Plus, people began to pick up on groups with names like Frontline Assembly, Pancao, Psychic TV, Liebach, and many others."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
